verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents first-party AI tooling for this story. Its official MCP server lets AI coding assistants "generate infrastructure code" [pulumi-docs-26] and works with Cursor, Claude Code and others [pulumi-docs-18]. Pulumi Neo takes plain-English requests such as "Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ" [pulumi-docs-20, pulumi-docs-32], and Agent Skills teach AI assistants Pulumi workflows [pulumi-docs-48]. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the code-generation workflow itself (output languages, quality, review steps), clarity on whether Neo emits editable program code versus only executing changes, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
